title: What does it mean?
text: The expression $$b^a b^c$$ means the product of ( $$a$$ copies of $$b$$ multiplied together ) with ( $$c$$ copies of $$b$$ multiplied together )

title: Count the b's
text: How many $$b$$ s are in the product of ( $$a$$ copies of $$b$$ multiplied together ) with ( $$c$$ copies of $$b$$ multiplied together )?
